articles.summary: New York April 1, 2026: eToro, the trading and investing platform, today announced that residents of New York State can now trade cryptoassets on eToro alongside stocks, ETFs and options. With this launch, eToro now offers access to digital assets across 48 states. New Yorkers can access crypto within eToro’s multi-asset platform supported by educational…
articles.title: eToro Unlocks Cryptoasset Investing for New Yorkers
